gold_references.label: Section 45
gold_references.role: definition of abetment of a thing

required_points: Section 45 defines abetment. A person abets the doing of a thing who: (a) instigates any person to do that thing; (b) engages in a conspiracy for the doing of that thing if an act or illegal omission takes place in pursuance thereof; or (c) intentionally aids, by any act or illegal omission, the doing of that thing.
Abetment can occur by wilful misrepresentation or wilful concealment of a material fact.
optional_points: Section 46 further defines an abettor as one who abets either the commission of an offence or an act that would be an offence if committed by a person capable by law.
forbidden_points: Abetment requires physical presence at the crime scene.
Abetment only covers instigation, not aid or conspiracy.

notes: Direct lookup. Section 45 is the foundational abetment definition.
